# Scenario: non–rate-limit ACME failures → .retries block + cert_issue_failed event.
#
# ACME directory points at a closed local port (connection refused), not the 429 stub.
# certs.triesCount=1 so the first failure blocks immediately; the next cycle skips the CA.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: cert issue failed fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

# --- Cycle 1: issuance fails → blocked + event ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'cert issuance failed'
stderr 'cert retry domain=e2e-retries.apinfra.test attempts=1/1'
stderr 'cert issue blocked domain=e2e-retries.apinfra.test'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/.retries
grep 'e2e-retries.apinfra.test' $HOME/.retries
grep 'blocked: true' $HOME/.retries
grep 'attempts: 1' $HOME/.retries
exists $HOME/.events
grep 'cert_issue_failed' $HOME/.events
grep 'e2e-retries.apinfra.test' $HOME/.events
! exists $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
! exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-retries.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

# --- Cycle 2: still blocked → skip CA (no obtain primary) ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'certificate issue blocked'
! stderr 'obtain primary'
stderr 'done duration='

grep 'blocked: true' $HOME/.retries
grep 'attempts: 1' $HOME/.retries
# Still a single cert_issue_failed line from cycle 1.
exec sh -c 'test "$(grep -c cert_issue_failed "$HOME/.events")" -eq 1'
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.triesCount=1
certs.blockHours=24
certs.provider=letsencrypt
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://127.0.0.1:1/directory
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://127.0.0.1:1/directory
certIssueTimeout=10s

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-retries.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"
    container_name: e2e-web-container

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
echo '127.0.0.1'

-- .env --
